dem.source: USGS 3DEP (The National Map 3DEPElevation ImageServer, best available)

vision.model: vision_any/2 (multi-year NAIP + lidar point statistics, LightGBM on hand maps; lidar canopy edge buffer)
vision.trained_on: hand maps of Spirit Hollow (hand_zones_ll.json) and Mozingo Lake (tee_strategy.HOLES)
vision.trees: 3DEP lidar HAG > 2.5 m; Meta CHM in 0.3% lidar gaps; golfer trees line = canopy (HAG > 2.5 m, clumps >= 100 m2) buffered -1 m (learned on the hand maps)
vision.native: LightGBM P(native) >= None on multi-year NAIP [2022, 2021, 2020, 2018, 2016, 2014] + lidar point statistics + texture + terrain + OSM distances (course-relative), trained on the Spirit Hollow + Mozingo hand maps (2026-10-17T11:15Z)
vision.water: OSM water + NDWI open water near OSM water/streams + DTM channel of OSM streams + unmown banks
vision.lidar: 3DEP point cloud (EPT/PDAL) per-1 m return statistics: SD_EasternSD_3_2020

ob.model: ob_infer/1 (course outline + houses/parcels/roads, offsets fitted on Spirit Hollow hand OB)

frame_doc: zones_ll / *_ll are WGS84 [lon, lat] and frame-free. zones, tee, dot270, green, hole_line are the yard frame of tee_set (x = yds right of the tee line, y = -yds along it; tee (0,0), dot270 (0,-270)), derived by platform/package.py reframe(). Pixel frame per hole: px = pixel.tee_px + pixel.ppy * (x, y) (920 x 2000, the image / book frame).
